function.arguments: {"message":"When you re‑import a corrected file, Meridian matches rows by email (or by a unique ID if you provided one). If a row that already imported appears again unchanged, the system recognises it as the same record and updates it in place – it won’t create a duplicate. However, if the correction you made was to the email address or the unique identifier used for matching, the importer can’t tell it’s the same row, so it will add a new record. In that case, remove the rows that already succeeded from the corrected file before you run the import again."}

arguments.message: When you re‑import a corrected file, Meridian matches rows by email (or by a unique ID if you provided one). If a row that already imported appears again unchanged, the system recognises it as the same record and updates it in place – it won’t create a duplicate. However, if the correction you made was to the email address or the unique identifier used for matching, the importer can’t tell it’s the same row, so it will add a new record. In that case, remove the rows that already succeeded from the corrected file before you run the import again.
